sanskrit: yas tvā mṛtyur abhyadhatta jāyamānaṃ supāśayā | taṃ te satyasya hastābhyām ud amuñcad bṛhaspatiḥ ||
english: The death that had bound you at birth with its fair noose — from that very bond Bṛhaspati has freed you with the hands of Truth.

sanskrit: abhi tvā jarimāhita gām ukṣaṇām iva rajjvā | vy anye yantu mṛtyavo yān āhur itarāñ chatam ||
english: Old age has been fastened upon you like a bull-calf bound with a rope. Let the other deaths depart — those hundred other ones of which they speak.

sanskrit: pra viśataṃ prāṇāpānāv anaḍvāhāv iva vrajam | śarīram asyāṅgāni jarimṇe nayataṃ yuvam ||
english: Let the in-breath and out-breath enter as two oxen enter the fold. Guide you two — the limbs of this person's body — onward to old age.

sanskrit: ihaiva staṃ prāṇāpānau memaṃ hāsiṣṭaṃ mṛtyave | ayaṃ jarimṇaḥ śevadhir ariṣṭa iha vardhatām ||
english: Remain here, O in-breath and out-breath; do not abandon this one to death. Let this treasure of old age grow here unharmed.

sanskrit: jarase tvā pari dadhmo jarase ni dhuyāmasi | jarā tvā bhadrayā neṣat | vy anye yantu mṛtyavo yān āhur itarāñ chatam ||
english: We wrap you round with old age; we shake you down into old age. May auspicious old age lead you forward. Let the other deaths depart — those hundred other ones of which they speak.

sanskrit: muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kam ajñātayakṣmād uta rājakṣmāt | grāhyā gṛbhīto yady eṣa etat tata indrāgnī pra mumuktam enam ||
english: I release you with oblation for life — from unknown wasting-sickness and from royal consumption. If this one has been seized by a grāhī-demon, from that, O Indra and Agni, release him.

sanskrit: yadi kṣitāyur yadi vā pareto yadi mṛtyor antikaṃ nīta eva | tam ā harāmi nirṛter upasthād aspārṣam enaṃ śataśāradāya ||
english: Whether his life-span is spent, or whether he has already passed away, or whether he has been led to the very proximity of death — him I bring back from the lap of Nirṛti; I have touched him over for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit: sahasrākṣeṇa śatavīryeṇa śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣam enam | indro yathainaṃ jarase nayāty ati viśvasya duritasya pāram ||
english: With the thousand-eyed oblation, with the hundred-powered, hundred-life-giving oblation I have brought him here — so that Indra may lead him to old age, beyond the far shore of all hardship.

sanskrit: śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamānaḥ śataṃ hemantāñ chatam u vasantān | śatam indrāgnī savitā bṛhaspatiḥ śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣam enam ||
english: Live a hundred autumns, growing ever greater; a hundred winters and a hundred springs. Indra and Agni, Savitṛ, Bṛhaspati — with the hundred-life oblation I have brought him here.

sanskrit: yat te annaṃ bhuvaspata ākṣiyeta pṛthivīm anu | tasya nas tvaṃ bhuvaspate saṃ pra yaccha prajāpate ||
english: O Lord of Existence (Bhuvaspati), whatever food of yours is being consumed along the earth — of that, O Lord of Existence, O Prajāpati, bestow bounty upon us.

sanskrit: vyātte parameṣṭhino brahmaṇāpīpadāma tam | saṃvatsarasya daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ hetis taṃ sam adhād abhi ||
english: Into the gaping mouth of Parameṣṭhin we have crammed him with the sacred formula. The bolt of the Year has struck him down with both its fangs.

sanskrit: iyaṃ taṃ bhavastv āhutiḥ samid devī sahīyasī | rājño varuṇasya bandho asi so 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ahne rātraye badhāna ||
english: May this oblation, this divine and mighty kindling-stick, be his downfall. You are the bond of King Varuṇa — bind that man, son of such-and-such a mother, to day and to night.

sanskrit: mṛṇo 'si deva savitar gāyatreṇa chandasā mṛṇāmuṣya paśūn dvipadaś catuṣpadaḥ | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ jahi taṃ mṛṇa tasmai mā mīmṛḍas tasmai durāhā ||
english: You are the crusher, O divine Savitṛ — with the Gāyatrī metre crush that man's livestock, both the two-footed and the four-footed. He who hates us, he whom we hate — smite him, crush him; be not gracious to him; let there be hard going for him.
